source: Reverse-engineered from the running bomts PostgreSQL database on 2026-10-09
assumptions: This model records the existing eight-table production schema without structural redesign.
The approved target owner is bomts_app; ownership is not applied until the operational restart approval.
Qdrant collection structure is operational vector storage and is documented separately from relational tables.
open_questions: Free-text question, answer, feedback, and crawled content may contain personal information; retention and deletion rules need a separate decision.
Schema migrations currently rely on SQLAlchemy create_all; a versioned migration tool should be considered separately.
